label: create_lending_type
query:
CREATE GRAPH TYPE /default_schema/`onto_verify_5602e6b6cefa_lending_type` AS {
  NODE TYPE `Borrower` (LABEL `Borrower` {`borrower_id` STRING NOT NULL, `party_type` STRING NOT NULL, `identity_evidence` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`borrower_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Lender` (LABEL `Lender` {`lender_id` STRING NOT NULL, `institution_scope` STRING NOT NULL, `name` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`lender_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Loan` (LABEL `Loan` {`loan_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `principal_amount` DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`loan_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `LoanApplication` (LABEL `LoanApplication` {`application_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`application_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `CreditFacility` (LABEL `CreditFacility` {`facility_id` STRING NOT NULL, `limit_amount` DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME, PRIMARY KEY (`facility_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Disbursement` (LABEL `Disbursement` {`disbursement_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `amount` DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`disbursement_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Repayment` (LABEL `Repayment` {`repayment_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `amount` DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL, `currency` STRING NOT NULL, `status` STRING NOT NULL, `reverses_id` STRING, PRIMARY KEY (`repayment_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `CreditInquiry` (LABEL `CreditInquiry` {`inquiry_id` STRING NOT NULL, `source_system` STRING NOT NULL, `source_record_id` STRING NOT NULL, `event_time` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `purpose` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`inquiry_id`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Phone` (LABEL `Phone` {`phone_token` STRING NOT NULL, `normalization_scope` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`phone_token`)}),
  NODE TYPE `Account` (LABEL `Account` {`institution_id` STRING NOT NULL, `account_token` STRING NOT NULL, `account_namespace` STRING NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`institution_id`, `account_token`, `account_namespace`)}),
  EDGE TYPE `BORROWS` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `BORROWS` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Loan`),
  EDGE TYPE `PROVIDES` (`Lender`)-[LABEL `PROVIDES` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Loan`),
  EDGE TYPE `APPLIES` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `APPLIES` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`LoanApplication`),
  EDGE TYPE `SUBMITTED_TO` (`LoanApplication`)-[LABEL `SUBMITTED_TO` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Lender`),
  EDGE TYPE `HAS_FACILITY` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `HAS_FACILITY` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`CreditFacility`),
  EDGE TYPE `GRANTS` (`Lender`)-[LABEL `GRANTS` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`CreditFacility`),
  EDGE TYPE `DRAWS_ON` (`Loan`)-[LABEL `DRAWS_ON` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`CreditFacility`),
  EDGE TYPE `HAS_DISBURSEMENT` (`Loan`)-[LABEL `HAS_DISBURSEMENT` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Disbursement`),
  EDGE TYPE `HAS_REPAYMENT` (`Loan`)-[LABEL `HAS_REPAYMENT` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Repayment`),
  EDGE TYPE `INQUIRY_SUBJECT` (`CreditInquiry`)-[LABEL `INQUIRY_SUBJECT` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Borrower`),
  EDGE TYPE `INQUIRY_BY` (`CreditInquiry`)-[LABEL `INQUIRY_BY` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Lender`),
  EDGE TYPE `USES_PHONE` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `USES_PHONE` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Phone`),
  EDGE TYPE `USES_ACCOUNT` (`Borrower`)-[LABEL `USES_ACCOUNT` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, `valid_from` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, `valid_to` ZONED DATETIME, `observed_at` ZONED DATETIME NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`),
  EDGE TYPE `PAYS_TO` (`Disbursement`)-[LABEL `PAYS_TO` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`Account`)
}

  EDGE TYPE `DOCUMENTS_OBSERVATION` (`EvidenceRecord`)-[LABEL `DOCUMENTS_OBSERVATION` {`relation_id` STRING NOT NULL, MULTIEDGE KEY (`relation_id`)}]->(`DeviceObservation`)
